text_blocks.snippet: Erectile tissue damage can manifest through several symptoms, most prominently including erectile dysfunction (ED). Other signs can include penile pain, bruising, or a noticeable curvature of the penis. In cases of more severe damage, such as a penile fracture, there may be a popping or cracking sound, immediate loss of erection, and blood in the urine.
